violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. Large tube of ground beef stored on storage unit shelf in walk in cooler next to ready to lettuce.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (deli meat sandwiches) prepared and packaged by a processing plant was not date marked.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in the proper location to protect from contamination. Crock pots and roasters stored on floor in office/corridor/utility area.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Plastic forks stored on customer counter should be stored with the handles up. Currently stored in cup with tines up. Paper towels being stored on floor in guest seating area. Box of food service containers stored on floor in storage room. Store food service related items off floor.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet rooms are not provided with a self closing door.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Secondary container of poisonous or toxic material was not clearly identified to indicated contents. Blue handle chemical spray bottle not labeled as to contents.
Food service manager certification. — --Person in charge did not hold an approved food service manager certificate. Unable to verify/view current Food Safety Manager certificate.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Invert forks available for customers so handles are up.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door. Rest room doors not self closing.
Food service manager certification. — --Person in charge did not hold an approved food service manager certificate. Unable to verify/view current Food Safety Manager certificate.
